subtasks.title: Implement 3-tier resolution logic and carry-patch mode activation rules
details: Call `resolved_hub_url = resolve_hub_url(hub_url_flag=hub_url_flag, config_url=config.hub.endpoint_url)` for hub URL resolution
Resolve workspace slug inline: `resolved_slug = workspace_flag or os.environ.get('AF_WORKSPACE', '') or config.carry_patch.workspace`
Resolve PAT: use CLI `--token` first; if absent, call `resolve_hub_pat()` to read `AF_HUB_TOKEN`
Carry-patch mode is active only when both `resolved_slug` and `resolved_pat` are non-empty
If `--workspace` resolved but no token from any source: `click.echo(..., err=True)` and `sys.exit(1)` with PAT-required message
If carry-patch active but hub URL empty: `click.echo(..., err=True)` and `sys.exit(1)` with hub-URL-required message
If only hub URL resolved (no workspace/token): silently skip carry-patch, run normally

task_groups.title: Implement async startup helper with CWD validation sequence (REQ-3)

subtasks.title: Create async startup helper function and HubClient instantiation
details: In `packages/nightshift/nightshift/app.py`, define an async helper function (e.g. `async def _carry_patch_startup(resolved_hub_url, resolved_slug, resolved_pat, config)`) that encapsulates REQ-3 and REQ-5
Construct a single `HubClient` instance: `hub_client = HubClient(endpoint_url=resolved_hub_url, pat=resolved_pat)` inside the helper
This instance is reused for all API calls in both REQ-3 and REQ-5

subtasks.title: Implement workspace API validation steps (steps 1–3)
details: Call `workspace = await hub_client.get_workspace(resolved_slug)`; catch `HubAuthError` and `HubNotFoundError` → `click.echo(..., err=True)` + `sys.exit(1)` with diagnostic message
Check `workspace.workspace_mode == 'carry_patch'`; if not → `click.echo(..., err=True)` + `sys.exit(1)`
Check `workspace.clone_status == 'ready'`; if not → `click.echo(..., err=True)` + `sys.exit(1)` indicating clone not ready

subtasks.title: Implement git subprocess origin URL check (step 4)
details: Call `subprocess.run(['git', 'remote', 'get-url', 'origin'], stdout=PIPE, stderr=PIPE, timeout=10)` (blocking)
Catch `FileNotFoundError` → emit verbatim message `'git is not installed or not in PATH; nightshift requires git'` via `click.echo(..., err=True)` + `sys.exit(1)`
Catch `subprocess.TimeoutExpired` → `click.echo(..., err=True)` with timeout message + `sys.exit(1)`
If returncode != 0 → `click.echo(stderr_output, err=True)` + `sys.exit(1)`

subtasks.title: Implement origin URL comparison and success logging (steps 5–6)
details: Strip trailing whitespace from subprocess stdout and compare to `workspace.git_url`
If mismatch → `click.echo(f'Local origin URL {local_url!r} does not match workspace git_url {workspace.git_url!r}. cd into the correct directory.', err=True)` + `sys.exit(1)`
If all checks pass → `logging.info('CWD validation succeeded for workspace %s', resolved_slug)` and continue
Wire the async helper invocation: `asyncio.run(_carry_patch_startup(...))` from synchronous `main()` before `DaemonRunner.run()`
